//: Store requirements the mobile release must meet. Checked by tools/deploy/mobile.mjs so a deadline is a failing check rather than a rejection email.

android.targetSdkNote: From 31 Aug 2026 new apps and updates must target Android 16 (API 36). Existing listings need API 35 to stay available to new users. An extension to 1 Nov 2026 can be requested in Play Console.

ios.sdkNote: Since 28 Apr 2026 App Store Connect requires builds made with the iOS 26 SDK, which means Xcode 26. The deployment target can still be lower to support older devices.
ios.entitlementNote: Family Controls is request-only. Apple must grant it before a Screen Time shield can ship; budget review time, it is not a checkbox.

scaffold.note: The React Native app is not in this repository yet. mobile/bridge is the shared JavaScript it will import; mobile/android and mobile/ios are reference implementations of the native halves.
